blocks.title: 2. Cardio Intensity (Distance vs Strain)
blocks.caption: This chart tracks your daily running distance against your physiological strain (Whoop Strain) over the past 14 days, highlighting the intensity and impact of your cardio activities.

blocks.title: 3. Weekly Load Progression
blocks.caption: This graph shows your total training load, combining lifting volume and running distance, aggregated week-over-week. It helps in assessing your long-term training progression and avoiding overtraining.

blocks.title: 4. Fueling vs Output
blocks.caption: This chart compares your daily caloric intake (consumed) with your estimated caloric expenditure (burned) over the past 14 days, offering insights into your energy balance for recovery and performance.

blocks.title: 5. Recovery Response
blocks.caption: This graph illustrates your key recovery metrics, including Whoop Recovery, Garmin Body Battery, and 8Sleep Score, providing a comprehensive view of your physiological readiness and response to training.
